intent: A smoke-black hide barbarian set with grizzled wolf fur and pale bone, its right shoulder a horned beast's skull and its left arm bare, so the high camera reads a dark lopsided outline apart from the grey iron, brown leather, oxblood studded, oatmeal linen and grey-green fenscale sets.
reason: The asymmetric skull pauldron with one arm bare makes a lopsided outline no other family has, which is exactly the half-armoured fury in the brief.
first_fix: Its bare left arm and the skull pauldron are the idea; the chest under them is plain dark hide and could carry a fur edge or a strap of bone.
